title: finding(data-objectstack): `MetadataCache`'s `@example` documents a class the package's only export does not expose
body:
`packages/data-objectstack/src/cache/MetadataCache.ts` carries a JSDoc `@example`
on the exported `MetadataCache` class that opens with a construction a reader cannot
perform: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` declares exactly one export key (`.`), and
`MetadataCache` is not reachable through it. The class is imported internally by
`src/index.ts` (line 68) and used as a private field on `ObjectStackAdapter`; nothing
re-exports it.

## How it was measured

Found by the `@example` gate landed for objectui#8258
(`scripts/check-doc-example-types.mjs`). That gate compiles a documented example after
prepending an import of the documented symbol from its package's public entry, and it
PROBES that entry rather than assuming it. The probe is one throwaway module per
package-and-symbol pair, compiled through the same harness the verdict uses:

```
import { MetadataCache } from '@object-ui/data-objectstack';
```

produces TS2305, `Module '"@object-ui/data-objectstack"' has no exported member
'MetadataCache'`. 114 pairs were probed; 3 came back unimportable, and this is the only
one of the three that is a real absence — the other two (`validateSchema`,
`safeValidateSchema`) are published under the `@object-ui/types/zod` SUBPATH, which that
probe deliberately does not guess.

## Why this is filed rather than fixed in passing

objectui#8258's file surface is the new gate, its test and one `check:` line in the root
manifest. Which way this resolves is a real decision and not a mechanical edit:

1. **Export it.** If `MetadataCache` is meant to be usable, add it to the package's
   public entry. The `@example` then documents something a reader can follow.
2. **Stop documenting it as public.** If it is an internal cache, the `@example` is
   teaching a construction nobody outside the package can perform, and the example
   should go or be re-scoped to how the adapter is configured instead.

Option 2 looks likelier from the code — the field is `private metadataCache` and the
cache is configured through `config.cache` on the adapter — but that is a judgement about
the package's intended surface, which is triage's to make, not this card's.

## Severity

Low, and it is a documentation-truth defect rather than a runtime one: nothing breaks,
a reader following the example simply cannot get the import to resolve. The example's
block is on the objectui#8258 ledger today, declared as a usage fragment, so it is
already visible as a named debt rather than an invisible one.

Filed unassigned and unlabelled beyond `finding`; triage owns the priority. Written by
an agent seat while implementing objectui#8258.
